items.raw_excerpt: Explore the rising trend of "Cosmeticorexia" among Kerala schoolchildren, revealing its psychological and physical impacts on youth.
items.summary_en: Many schoolchildren in Kerala are becoming addicted to cosmetics. Experts call this trend cosmeticorexia. It affects children's bodies and minds at a young age.
items.summary_ko: 케랄라의 많은 학생들이 화장품에 중독되고 있습니다. 전문가들은 이 현상을 코스메티코렉시아라고 부릅니다. 어린 나이부터 몸과 마음에 나쁜 영향을 주고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Make-up addiction is hurting schoolchildren in Kerala

items.raw_excerpt: From a 1936 Triumph Dolomite Roadster and a wartime Mercury Eight to modern Ferraris and bespoke McLarens, the event puts automotive history and design on display at IMBA Theatre.
items.summary_en: Singapore's Concours d'Elegance brings classic cars, supercars, and cinematic flair to Gardens by the Bay. From a 1936 Triumph Dolomite Roadster to modern Ferraris and bespoke McLarens, the event puts automotive history and design on display at IMBA Theatre.

items.raw_excerpt: A native water mammal once dismissed as a "water rat" is quietly thriving in Melbourne's waterways, according to a new University of Melbourne mapping project.
items.summary_en: Researchers mapped Melbourne's waterways and found a native water mammal called the rakali doing well. The rakali is sometimes called a water rat. The new mapping project is from the University of Melbourne.
items.summary_ko: 멜버른 대학교 연구팀이 도시의 물길을 지도로 조사한 결과, 자생 수서 포유류인 라칼리가 잘 살고 있는 것으로 나타났다. 라칼리는 흔히 '물쥐'로 불리기도 한다. 새 지도 작성 프로젝트는 멜버른 대학교에서 진행됐다.
items.title_en: Map shows rakali thriving in Melbourne's waterways
items.title_ko: 멜버른 물길에서 자생 수서 포유류 라칼리 번성
items.title_original: Map finds native water mammal rakali thriving in Melbourne's waterways

items.raw_excerpt: Kerala's fishing community vows to resist corporate control over black sand resources, asserting threats to their livelihoods and rights.
items.summary_en: Fishing families in Kerala say they will fight a plan to open their black sand resources to companies. They say the move threatens their livelihoods and rights. The community promises to resist.
items.summary_ko: 케랄라의 어업 가족들이 검은 모래 자원을 기업에 개방하려는 계획에 맞서 싸우겠다고 밝혔습니다. 이들은 이 계획이 자신들의 생계와 권리를 위협한다고 주장합니다. 지역 공동체는 저항을 약속했습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: The premium Argentine Angus brand, developed in partnership with Diego Maradona's family, makes its Singapore debut in a special menu at L'Antica Pizzeria Da Michele, honouring the football icon's enduring ties to Naples.
items.summary_en: A premium Argentine Angus beef brand made with Diego Maradona's family now comes to Singapore. It appears in a special menu at L'Antica Pizzeria Da Michele. The food honors Maradona's close ties to the city of Naples.

items.raw_excerpt: All players playing at the 2026 Rugby League World Cup will be paid AU$850 per week as a standard match fee, but individual federations can pay their players more if they can afford to.
items.summary_en: All players at the 2026 Rugby League World Cup will be paid AU$850 a week as a standard match fee. Individual federations can pay their players more if they can afford to. The fee applies to every player in the tournament.

items.raw_excerpt: Several flights were unable to take off or land at Tan Son Nhat International Airport in Ho Chi Minh City on Thursday evening after three kites fitted with flashing lights were spotted in the sky.

items.raw_excerpt: The Consumers Association of Singapore received 1,124 complaints against the beauty industry in the first half of the year, more than double the 558 complaints received in the first half of 2025.
items.summary_en: Singapore's consumer watchdog got 1,124 complaints about the beauty industry in the first half of 2026. That is more than double the 558 complaints from a year earlier. Prepayment losses reached S$1.9 million, nearly 18 times higher than last year.
items.summary_ko: 싱가포르 소비자 단체가 올해 상반기 미용업계에 대한 민원을 1,124건 접수했다. 이는 지난해 같은 기간의 558건보다 두 배 이상 늘어난 수치다. 선결제 피해액은 190만 싱가포르 달러로 1년 전보다 약 18배 늘었다.

items.raw_excerpt: It's a traditional Norwegian summer activity packed with cultural quirks.
